dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit dark, well-defined perimeters with a sharp gradient transition into high-intensity, lighter centers. The most prominent dorsal annuli show slightly jagged outer perimeters.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High concentration of high-intensity pixel clusters localized along the mid-lateral line. Core pixel concentrations are highest where multiple ring-like structures intersect or merge into solid bright patches.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest mid-dorsal macro-annuli form an elongated obtuse triangle. An additional four-point irregular polygon is formed by the centroids of a cluster of smaller blobs on the lower posterior-lateral flank.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive dark concentric rings surrounding the ocular regions and a dense cluster of small, uniform circular points on the snout.
